description: This class defines email configuration settings such as host, port, protocol, credentials, and SMTP options, with functionality to serialize these settings to a JSON string.

classes.name: EmailConfig
classes.description: A Java class representing email configuration parameters, with getter/setter methods and JSON serialization capability.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the email configuration data into a JSON string.

methods.name: isSmtpAuth
methods.description: Returns whether SMTP authentication is enabled.

methods.name: setEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Sets the path for email templates.

methods.name: getEmailTemplatesPath
methods.description: Returns the path for email templates.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Gets the port for email server connection.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port for email server connection.

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.description: Gets the protocol used for email transmission.

methods.name: setProtocol
methods.description: Sets the protocol used for email transmission.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Gets the username for email authentication.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for email authentication.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Gets the password for email authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for email authentication.
